SELECT S.VCRNUM_0 CODE ,'Receipt No:'+S.VCRNUM_0+'
' +'Heat No:'+S.LOT_0+'
' +'TV No:'+LEFT(SLO_0, 4)+'
' +'Routing:'+ISNULL(S.ITMREF_0,'')+'
' +'Quantity/Coil Num:'+CAST(CAST(SUM(S.QTYSTU_0) AS REAL) AS VARCHAR)+'/'+CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) DESP ,S.ITMREF_0 ITMNO ,ITM.ZGRADENO_0 GRADENO ,LOT_0 LOT ,LEFT(SLO_0, 4) TV ,ISNULL(H.DOCNUM,CONCAT_WS('-',S.VCRNUM_0,S.LOT_0, LEFT(SLO_0, 4))) DOCNUM ,COUNT(*) QTY ,CAST(SUM(S.QTYSTU_0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) QTYSTU ,S.PCU_0 ,S.BPRNUM_0 BPSNUM ,S.VCRNUM_0 VCRNUM ,S.CREDAT_0 CREDAT ,U.ROUCOD ROUCODCK FROM #LC.X3DATA#STOJOU S INNER JOIN #LC.X3DATA#ITMMASTER ITM ON S.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN QAINSPH H ON H.LOT #LC.X3COLLATE# = S.LOT_0 AND H.TV #LC.X3COLLATE# = LEFT(SLO_0, 4) AND H.MFGNUM #LC.X3COLLATE# =S.VCRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN QAROU U ON U.ROUCOD #LC.X3COLLATE# = S.ITMREF_0 WHERE S.VCRTYP_0 = 6 AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ('RAW','FPP','MFL') AND S.CREDAT_0 > '#LINKDATE(-1,0,0,yyyy-MM-dd)#' GROUP BY S.ITMREF_0 ,ITM.ZGRADENO_0 ,LOT_0 ,LEFT(SLO_0, 4) ,H.DOCNUM ,S.PCU_0 ,S.BPRNUM_0 ,S.VCRNUM_0 ,S.CREDAT_0 ,U.ROUCOD ORDER BY S.CREDAT_0 DESC
